title: Coolant/Heating Plasma Systems — Overview
description: Signature edition. Coolant/Heating Plasma Systems (Plasma Amor Grade): Overview. details: Humans shed about 100 W at rest and 300-500 W in heavy work; cooling must match metabolic heat.
Latent heat is the trick: melting 1 kg of PCM at 180 kJ/kg absorbs the same heat as warming 43 kg of water by 1 C.
Cooling time is roughly stored latent heat divided by heat load: a 1 kg PCM vest at 200 W lasts about 15 minutes per 180 kJ.
Liquid garments win on duration: a pumped loop rejects heat continuously as long as the chiller runs.
Heat loss is conduction, convection, and radiation; wind attacks convection and dominates perceived cold.
A 10 W heater offsets roughly the resting heat loss of a hand or foot zone, not a whole torso.
